description: Extract structured JSON data from one or more web pages using an LLM. Provide a JSON schema and/or a natural-language prompt describing what to pull. Example: hyperbrowser_extract({ urls: ["https://example.com"], prompt: "Get the product name and price", schema: { type: "object", properties: { name: { type: "string" }, price: { type: "string" } } }, _apiKey: "your-key" })

examples.prompt: Extract the product name, price, and availability status

_apiKey.description: Hyperbrowser API key. Sign up at https://app.hyperbrowser.ai (docs: https://docs.hyperbrowser.ai/).

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the data to extract (used with or instead of schema).

schema.description: JSON Schema object describing the shape of the data to extract, e.g. { type: "object", properties: { title: { type: "string" } } }.

urls.description: One or more URLs to extract data from.

name: hyperbrowser_extract
title: Hyperbrowser Extract
